sources.quote: From Proto-Slavic *lipa. Related to ли́па (lýpa, “linden”), referring to linden trees which bloom at this time of year, with -ень (-enʹ). Cognates include Belarusian ліпень (lipjenʹ, “July”), Polish lipiec, Russian липец (lipec), and Serbo-Croatian lipanj (“June”).

липень.text: From Proto-Slavic *lipa. Related to ли́па (lýpa, “linden”), referring to linden trees which bloom at this time of year, with -ень (-enʹ). Cognates include Belarusian ліпень (lipjenʹ, “July”), Polish lipiec, Russian липец (lipec), and Serbo-Croatian lipanj (“June”).
